title: First-Line Encorafenib Plus Cetuximab for Metastatic BRAF V600E-Mutant Colorectal Cancer
brief_summary: Clinical trial 9 for Metastatic Colorectal Adenocarcinoma. This is a Phase 3 study.
detailed_description: This clinical trial evaluates the efficacy and safety of investigational therapy for Metastatic Colorectal Adenocarcinoma. Participants will be assessed for response, progression-free survival, and overall survival.
inclusion_criteria: Metastatic Colorectal Cancer (mCRC); Locally confirmed BRAF V600E-mutant; Previously untreated (0 prior regimens) in metastatic setting; ECOG PS 0-1; Measurable disease
exclusion_criteria: Locally confirmed or unknown MSI-H or dMMR; Symptomatic brain metastases; Active bacterial or viral infections
eligibility_criteria: Metastatic Colorectal Cancer (mCRC); Locally confirmed BRAF V600E-mutant; Previously untreated (0 prior regimens) in metastatic setting; ECOG PS 0-1; Measurable disease. Exclusion: Locally confirmed or unknown MSI-H or dMMR; Symptomatic brain metastases; Active bacterial or viral infections
